enron ' s path to the top
by joann s . lublin
wall street journal
february 16 , 2001
enron corp . may be the best - known name in the new economy , but for much of
the past decade , the big energy trader was a little - known company with a
smaller revenue base .
enron expanded rapidly as a deregulated electricity market emerged in the late
1990 s , transforming the company from an electricity - trading boutique to a
global conglomerate with a market capitalization of $ 61.5 billion at the
close of regular trading thursday . since 1995 alone , enron ' s revenues have
increased 33 % annually .
" we are really the only place where electricity and natural gas are traded
globally , " says michael l . miller , enron ' s chief financial officer . " if
you want to trade in the new economy , you can ' t go anywhere else . "
enron ' s revenues grew from $ 3.8 billion in 1995 to $ 19.6 billion in 2000 ,
according to the company . in the past 12 months , enron ' s revenues were $ 19. 3
billion , a 33 % increase from the same period a year earlier , the company
says .
enron ' s rapid growth has been accompanied by a series of strategic moves that
have helped it expand its reach into new markets . the company became a leading
merchant of electricity and natural gas , owning power plants and pipelines .
enron has also secured its position in the telecommunications and energy
markets by buying stakes in power plants , pipelines and telecommunications
firms around the world .
enron ' s growth has been driven by three factors : deregulation of the
telecommunications and energy industries , use of technology to manage complex
trading deals and its trading expertise . the company ' s trading expertise
comes from jeffrey r . skilling , the company ' s president , and andrew s.
fastow , the firm ' s chief financial officer .
" enron has grown by taking advantage of deregulation and the internet , " says
richard schwartz , a securities analyst at thomson financial services . " anyone
can use the internet to do business , but enron ' s success has been in getting
all the pieces to work together . "
when the telecommunications industry was deregulated in 1996 , the company
bought a 25 % stake in idt corp . , a long - distance company .
enron entered the broadband - cable field in 1999 with the purchase of providence
starnet inc . , a broadband - cable company , for $ 5.75 billion . the purchase
gave enron a foothold in the broadband - cable market with 1.8 million
subscribers . enron plans to use the cable system to sell internet access and
other services to homes and businesses .
in the natural - gas industry , the company entered the business of building
pipelines in 1998 with the purchase of pmi energy services for $ 4.2 billion .
the purchase gave enron a stake in the business of building pipelines .
" enron is a market - maker , " says richard j . seymour , a securities analyst at
morgan stanley dean witter . " it operates in a number of different markets that
are deregulating and is taking advantage of the deregulation . "
enron has also developed a reputation for being an innovator .
" one of the things that i really admire about enron is that they have been
pioneers in the energy industry , " says richard carlson , chief executive of
the gas utility division of american electric power . " they have been able to
use technology well to improve their business . "
enron also has a strong capital markets presence , says david a . morgan ,
chief executive of bear stearns & co . " they ' ve made a real effort to develop
their capital markets business . "
enron derives 81 % of its revenue from natural - gas and electricity trading and
distribution , and 13 % comes from telecommunications and broadband services ,
according to the company .

enron corporation
enron corporation , the world ' s leading energy company , today announced that
it has completed the acquisition of one of the largest independent power
generators in north america . the acquisition is expected to add more than
$ 200 million to enron ' s earnings per share in 2001 and more than $ 500 million
to earnings per share by 2002 . the acquisition significantly increases
enron ' s wholesale electric power portfolio , which now totals 52 , 000 megawatts
of power capacity and 14 , 000 megawatts of power generation . enron also
announced that it has reached agreement to sell one of its oldest and most
successful businesses , enron oil & gas , for $ 1 . 2 billion to a group of
private equity investors . the sale of enron oil & gas is expected to add more
than $ 100 million to enron ' s earnings per share in 2001 and more than $ 200
million to earnings per share in 2002 . both transactions are subject to
regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions .
" our acquisition of this independent power generator , coupled with the
divestiture of enron oil & gas , will enable us to focus on our core business
of helping customers manage their energy costs and risks , " said jeff
skilling , enron ' s president . " the transactions will have significant
immediate and long - term earnings - enhancing benefits for enron shareholders .
we plan to use the proceeds from the enron oil & gas sale to reduce our
debt . "
the acquisition of the independent power generator is the latest in a series
of transactions between enron and lummus . it complements the recent
acquisition by enron of the lummus / enron manufacturing corporation . the
combined entity is now the world ' s largest independent power generator ,
with more than 52 , 000 megawatts of power capacity and 14 , 000 megawatts of
power generation . the company ' s assets include more than 1 , 000 megawatts
of power generation in the us and approximately 2 , 000 megawatts of generation
in europe and asia . the increased generation capacity will greatly enhance
enron ' s ability to meet the growing demand for power from its wholesale
electricity customers in the us and around the world . the acquisition also
significantly increases enron ' s power trading business and will enable the
company to provide its customers with more and better priced power options .
the sale of enron oil & gas will enable enron to focus on its core business
of helping customers manage their energy costs and risks . enron oil & gas
provides oil , natural gas and liquefied natural gas to customers in north
america and around the world . enron ' s oil & gas operations include the
production of oil and natural gas from north american on - shore and offshore
properties , and the supply of oil and natural gas to customers in north
america and around the world . enron oil & gas also provides a full range of
natural gas transportation and logistics services , including the construction
of gas pipelines , compression and storage facilities , and the operation of
pipelines . the sale of enron oil & gas is expected to be completed by the end
of the first quarter of 2001 . the divestiture will result in a reduction in
enron ' s work force of approximately 300 employees .

fw : us financials and new england gas regis , this is a summary of my discussion about the new england gas business with dan and john . we believe that the business is in decline , and we believe that this is due to 1 ) the high fix costs ( $ 1.0 - 1.9 / mmbtu ) and 2 ) the low variable costs ( ~$ 0. 10 / mm b t u ) . there is a reason that the natural gas business is not a pure play on the price of natural gas . net margins are almost always the same , regardless of what the price of natural gas does . this is because the marginal cost of natural gas is very low . in order to make money , you need to raise the price of natural gas above the marginal cost of producing it . the figure attached has a breakdown of the fix and variable costs . the fix costs are amortized over a fixed number of cubic feet . when you have a business that is declining in volume , you get poorer and poorer margins because your amortized costs ( fix ) are spread over less units . so , if you eliminate all costs , you can see that we make almost nothing on this business . the question is , do we want to spend money to fix the costs and restructure the business ? press release
enron , cpc team up to create a new energy company
enron corporation and cpc international , inc . today announced a strategic
alliance to create a new energy company , enron global energy corp . ( egc ) ,
to develop , finance and operate energy projects throughout the world . under
the terms of the agreement , enron will transfer its energy assets to egc ,
which will be 60 percent owned by enron and 40 percent owned by cpc . enron
will have a controlling 51 percent vote on the egc board of directors .
enron and cpc will contribute their respective asset portfolios to egc .
these portfolios include an extensive lineup of power plants and oil and gas
production and transportation assets around the globe . the new company
anticipates generating approximately $ 1 billion in annual earnings and
$ 100 million in annual cash flow , with the potential to nearly double these
amounts once the assets are fully developed .
enron ' s energy assets include 7 , 000 megawatts of power generation capacity ,
including four combined cycle gas turbines , which are among the most
efficient and environmentally friendly power plants in the world . enron ' s
energy assets also include a 500 , 000 barrel per day oil pipeline , a 1 , 200
mile natural gas transmission system and interests in oil and gas projects
around the world . cpc ' s energy assets include a portfolio of power plants ,
including cogeneration facilities , as well as oil and gas production and
transportation assets .
enron ' s energy group has long been a market leader , developing one of the
world ' s largest energy portfolios and successfully and profitably
trading energy around the world . enron ' s power generation assets have
increased from 1 , 000 megawatts to more than 7 , 000 megawatts since 1992 . by
developing energy assets in emerging markets , enron has helped to stimulate
economic development while also expanding its energy portfolio .
egc will be a leading independent energy company in the world and will
possess one of the world ' s largest energy portfolios . the senior management
team will include enron ' s current energy group management and senior
management of cpc ' s energy division . the new company will be headquartered
in houston , texas , and will have operations in the u . s . , the caribbean , the
netherlands , india , singapore , hong kong , china and australia . for more
information about the company , log on to www . enroncorp . com .
enron is a natural gas , electricity , communications and paper company with
interests around the world . enron is the world ' s largest wholesale trader of
natural gas and electricity and the largest independent power producer in the
u . s . enron ' s communications division , enron business communications
services ( bcs ) , provides voice , data and video services to more than 500 , 000
business customers in 86 countries . enron is also a leading marketer of
pulpwood and paper products . enron ' s common stock is traded on the new york
stock exchange ( enr ) and the london stock exchange ( enrny ) .
cpc international , inc . is a leading global supplier of energy , food and
fibers . cpc has expertise in the development , construction , acquisition ,
operation and financing of energy , power and related facilities , and has
extensive operations in the united states , europe , south america , the
caribbean , asia and the middle east .

unemployment insurance . 505 - 841 - 4500 . unemployment .   505 - 841 - 4500 . the unemployment insurance program is a federal - state partnership that provides temporary income for workers who become unemployed through no fault of their own .   the program provides up to 26 weeks of benefits for eligible claimants .  in new mexico , the program is administered by the unemployment insurance division of the new mexico department of job and family services .  to qualify for unemployment benefits , you must have worked a minimum number of weeks and earned a minimum amount of wages during your base period .  the base period is the first four of the last five completed calendar quarters preceding the date you file your claim .   the national unemployment insurance program was created by the social security act of 1935 .   the federal unemployment trust fund was established by the social security act of 1935 and is the source of funds for the unemployment insurance program .   other sources of funds are state unemployment insurance taxes paid by employers and interest earned on the trust fund .   the federal government reimburses states for 90 percent of their administrative costs for the unemployment insurance program and 50 percent of their benefits costs .   to learn more about the unemployment insurance program , you may visit the unemployment insurance division of the new mexico department of job and family services website at www . unemployment . nm . gov or the u.s . department of labor website at www . dol . gov / ui .   for more information , please contact the unemployment insurance division at 505 - 841 - 4500 .
